ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Minnesota's Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota, following the money trail to identify those responsible and determine the extent of the losses.
questions: How much money was improperly claimed?
Who is responsible for the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in Minnesota's child care system. By following the money trail, we can identify those responsible and hold them accountable.
